analyzed_vuln.description: `Mat_VarGetSize` recursively walks nested struct/cell members and assumes every `matvar_t` it visits has a valid `dims` array whenever `rank > 0`. In the non-struct/cell/sparse branch it sets `bytes` then calls `Mat_MulDims(matvar, &bytes)`, and `Mat_MulDims` unconditionally reads `matvar->dims[i]`. For this PoV, a malformed nested variable has `rank > 0` but `dims == NULL` (or invalid), so `Mat_MulDims` dereferences a null/near-null pointer and crashes at mat.c:263. Root cause is missing validation/invariant enforcement in `Mat_VarGetSize` before propagating `matvar` into `Mat_MulDims` (crash manifests inside `Mat_MulDims`).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Fuzzer loads a crafted MAT v7.3 file containing nested variables (via struct/cell recursion in `Mat_VarGetSize`) where at least one child `matvar_t` has inconsistent metadata: positive `rank` but absent/invalid `dims`. During recursive size computation (`MatioRead` -> `Mat_VarGetSize` -> `Mat_VarGetSize` -> `Mat_MulDims`), the code enters the generic branch (`class_type` not struct/cell/sparse), calls `Mat_MulDims`, and triggers an invalid read of `matvar->dims[i]`.
